name: [🌀] Climb For Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Climb For Brainrots

How To Play:
🧗 Climb the ladders as far as you can
😂 Collect Brainrots from the sky islands you climb to
🍀 The further you climb, the better brainrots you can find!
💸 Your Brainrots generate you money!
⚡ Upgrade your SPEED to Climb Faster

💤 Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE!
